notes.title: A new update (1.6.9) is coming!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28289842/34aafc9e4e51e1be841d0962f1f61441aa1e795a.gif
Hey Barbarians, we want to show you a new interesting feature that will be available in the upcoming patch for ARENA ( an Age of Barbarians story ). 
The next update (1.6.9) will add the possibility to move up and down in the fighting stages. 😉
This "3rd dimension" adds more strategy and variety to the fights.

Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Hey Barbarians, the update 1.6.7 is ready:
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289842/a346d5496891961b9a34859c0f22d88e514bf240.png
We'll do our best to fix all the issues reported and update the game on regular basis. Thank you!

ARENA an Age of Barbarians story 1.6.7

- Game engine optimized, now it should run smoother.
- Sometimes if kicked an enemy was pushed too far away, fixed.
- If too close to the sorcerer it could not shoot the fireball, fixed.
- Sometimes the enemy's animation castrated and divided into two were glitched, fixed.
- An English dialogue presented some mistakes, fixed.
- Prisons, some translations were missing, fixed.
- Special could accidentally start if you're engaged in Close Combat, fixed.
- Which: AI improved, moreover now she can block player's attacks.
- Tentacles AI improved.

notes.title: Hey Barbarians, the update 1.6.6 is ready!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28289842/08036d47b214d8b6a5d8e605d9e6c9863a56e62e.jpg

A new Deadly minigame is waiting for you "Run for your life"!
We'll do our best to fix all the issues reported and update the game on regular basis. 
Thank you!

_________________


ARENA an Age of Barbarians story 1.6.6

- Memory required is now better managed.
- Engine: stability implemented.
- Engine: performance implemented.
- Jailer: A glitch appear when you block his whip, fixed.
- Some minor glitches fixed.
- Transition from an area to another, now are smoother.
- Sometimes the Enemies could hit you even if they give you their back, fixed.

Improvements:
- New Controller Cofig Menu.
- Controller response and performance improved.
- Now the game achieve the Full controller support.
- Minigame: From now on, you have only one chance to pass them, otherwise you lose 10'.
- Gore system improved: the blood sprays when it falls to the ground.


New Contents:
- A new Deadly minigame added "Run for your life".
- "RUN" Button: Now you can run by pressing a button (Default A).
- "JUMP" Button: While you run, press again the "Run" button to perform a jump (Default A).
- Option Menu (Minigame): added a new option "Death Trap Stages" : Play just once / Play until victory or death."

notes.title: Hey Barbarians, the new update 1.6.4 and DLC are available now!
notes.notes:

SHE-RED for ARENA an Age of Barbarians story is Now Available!
Prepare yourself, because she's a totally kick-ass heroine.
The New DLC is available for only $1,99!
In addition, we have taken this opportunity to release the update 1.6.4 which include a NEW Random Dungeon, two achievements and a new electric trap!

________________________

- If you play with the Keyboard the Guard had a graphic glitch, fixed.
- Deathbringer: if he was killed by the sabertooth, there was not continue, fixed.
- Deathbringer: if he was killed by a fire trap, sometimes the animation could not start, fixed.
- The Amazon pit: If you play as the Deathbringer the impaled animation was missing, fixed.
- Sion a death animationn was glitched, fixed.
- Some other minor glitches fixed.
- VS mode: some graphic glitches are now fixed.

Improvements:
- Minigame Fire ropes: Zoom effect added.
- Minigame Fire ropes: Now there is an indicator that help the player to pass the level.
- Some gameplay mechanics are now more balanced.
- Some enemies AI improved.
- Amazon: Shield block animation improved.

New Contents:
- A new Electric Trap.
- A New Random Dungeon Area.
- New achievement: the Deathbringer
- New achievement: She-Red

Stay tuned!

notes.title: ARENA an Age of Barbarians story - release date delayed again!
notes.notes:
ARENA an Age of Barbarians story will now release in August: Final Release date: Fri, 18 Aug 2017.
We understand that it might be disappointing to have to wait a little longer for the release, but we've tried our best to bring you the best game experience possible!
As you can see from the screenshots, we've taken the decision to add some very funny minigames inspired by classic movies and videogames and a lot of 80s Sword & Sorcery flavor.
We're also including a lot of black humour,  a good heavy metal atmosphere, sensuality and lot of gory violence.
Ah, don't forget that, as previously announced, we're also working on "Heavy Metal song" called "Age of Barbarians".
We'll keep you updated, so stay tuned!

notes.title: New Release Date for ARENA an Age of Barbarians story.
notes.notes:
New Release Date for ARENA an Age of Barbarians story.
To our beloved Barbarian fans:
We are sorry to say that we will not make the deadline for May 16th. We're going to need to delay the release until the 20th of June.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/570970/allnews/
Because the very advanced state of the game, we decided to Not release the game in Early Access. We can also reveal that the final price of the game will be 9,99$.
We are also working on a level/dungeon randomization, in the way that each run will be different from the previous one.
As we have already mentioned, the game have also multiple endings available for each characters.
Guys, all we can add, is taht the game is really cool and very funny to play.
More news will come very soon
Get ready, Barbarians :)
